label: The journey lane's trust boundary: the orchestrator in the main session dispatches a guarded explorer whose Bash runs only the pw wrapper and whose Read reaches only files committed in the run's worktree; the wrapper drives one browser session per account through a filtering proxy to an isolated instance with its own worktree, ports, data and HOME, never the owner's servers; page text returns only inside nonce fences; and a candidate leaves the machine only after a script reproduced it two of two and scrub found no secret from the run's 0600 ledger in it.
desc: The repo and .argus/live.json are the owner's and trusted; the app's pages are not. The orchestrator runs in the main session, unguarded, and reads the instance only through argus-live.mjs status --json and intake. It dispatches one sapu:ui-explorer per journey; the guard limits that agent to Bash, Read and StructuredOutput, its Bash to node <wrapper> pw with single-quoted or plain-word arguments, and its Read to files committed at HEAD in the run's worktree outside .argus/, with no Grep, Glob, Agent, Task or Workflow. The pw wrapper checks each explorer's token, budget, loop and deadline, allowlists every command and flag, keeps every URL inside the run's origins and offers no run-code or eval; what a page printed comes back inside a <<<PAGE- fence with a fresh nonce, and the explorer's return reaches the orchestrator inside a <<<RETURN- fence. The browsers reach the app only through the run's filtering proxy, which admits the run's origins and allow_origins. up builds an instance of its own (a worktree at HEAD, ports from port_range, its own HOME, Docker client and store, an environment holding only what live.json names) and refuses one that would reach the owner's servers, services or data; an egress check and a Docker runtime gate run at up and at every renew. Secrets live in the env file the guard keeps from every agent and reach a command only as ARGUS_SECRET_<NAME>; what the run meets goes to a 0600 secret ledger. A candidate is filed only after repro reproduced it two of two on a fresh instance and scrub found none of those secrets in the issue; a hit names where, never what, and an incomplete ledger files nothing. These checks are defence in depth, not a sandbox.
title: /journey — the trust boundary
